decls.name: SublemmaCharacterProductOrderConductor

paper_span.quote: characters with pairwise coprime conductors, $f(\chi_1\cdots \chi_m)=\prod_i f(\chi_i)$, ignoring conductor-1 trivial factors.

decls.rationale: Formalizes the conductor multiplicativity of Proposition A.11: for Dirichlet characters with pairwise coprime conductors, \(f(\chi_1\cdots\chi_m) = \prod_i f(\chi_i)\).
